newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Three die in police clash with Sao Paulo homeless.
newsitem.headline: Three die in police clash with Sao Paulo homeless.

text.p: Three men were killed and several were injured on Tuesday when protesters who had occupied a Sao Paulo low income housing project clashed with police sent to evict them, a police spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman said the clashes took place after 150 officers, including a police cavalry battalion, arrived with a court order to evict the 400 families who had illegally occupied the unfinished housing development.
Witnesses said the confrontation turned violent when the protesters threw stones and the police responded by shooting.
"They charged us with the cavalry. They provoked us first," said Francisco de Mattos, an unemployed worker and occupant of the housing project.
The latest incident of Sao Paulo police violence took place one month after a police officer was filmed shooting and killing an innocent man at a road block.

That killing triggered a massive public outcry and demands by civil rights groups for curbs to police authority. Sao Paulo authorities responded with a plan to dramatically overhaul the state police system.
